Additionally, it engages in LNG and ammonia assets; clean tech and energy transition; energies and alternative fuel value chain solutions; and digitalisation solutions. Additionally, it engages in LNG and ammonia assets; clean tech and energy transition; energies and alternative fuel value chain solutions; and digitalisation solutions.
